dialogues.speaker: Jarosznski
dialogues.text: Hello, do you require a loan for your business? Would you like to try our new "Happy Home Loan"? We're offering zero interest for the first three installments!

dialogues.speaker: Jarosznski
dialogues.text: We can discuss further, if you'd like. We offer packages tailored for different needs — and you're free to take your pick of the lot.

dialogues.speaker: Jarosznski
dialogues.text: Just provide your name, address, guarantor... and your detailed travel log for the past three months. The more detailed, the better.

dialogues.speaker: Jarosznski
dialogues.text: Don't think too much about it. All this is so we can offer you a more professional payment plan.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The people here don't seem to be the type to pay up honestly.

dialogues.speaker: Jarosznski
dialogues.text: I thought the same way at first. But in reality, our rate of reimbursement is higher than even Fontaine's branches.

dialogues.speaker: Jarosznski
dialogues.text: Maybe it's because I tell our clients that the Northland Bank will provide "suitable" jobs to those who can't pay off their debts, to help them return to their normal lives as soon as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Jarosznski
dialogues.text: Hehe, maybe it's magic? After hearing that spiel, the at-risk clients always, always end up settling their debts in just a few days.

dialogues.speaker: Jarosznski
dialogues.text: Of course. But remember to come back if you change your mind.
